title: Fenton Schema Standardizer
description: Dedicated profile for 06_schema standardisation: it reads the authoritative SOP (D:\fenton_papers\_sop_06schema_标准与格式标准化_2026-10-23.md) and standardises whatever schema the main agent hands over - field names, nesting, value/unit/raw triples, unit whitelist, empty-value placeholders, ordering - then writes the standardised file plus a change log. Has read tools + write_file, with 5,000,000-character (about 5M token) per-call input/output caps for both reading and writing.
